translations.web: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
translations.bsb: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory:
translations.kjv: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
